title: Kanelbullar (Swedish Cinnamon Knots)
summary: Cardamom dough folded around cinnamon butter, twisted into knots and topped with pearl sugar.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
pearl sugar or roughly crushed sugar cubes

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Warm the milk and butter until the butter melts and the mix is just warm (about 37 °C); mix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and salt, add the milk mix and knead 8 min until smooth.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave about 1 h until doubled.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Beat the soft butter, brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll the dough to a 40 x 30 cm rectangle, spread with the filling and fold it in three like a letter to 40 x 10 cm.

steps.title: Knot
steps.text: Cut across into 16 strips, stretch and twist each, then wind it twice around two fingers and tuck the end through to make a knot.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Set on the lined trays, cover and leave 45 min until puffy. Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with egg, sprinkle with pearl sugar and bake 10-12 min until golden brown.

tips: Grind cardamom fresh for the best scent.
Keep the filling soft so it spreads easily.
Do not overbake; they should stay soft.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
